results.memory: On October 14, 2026, User, Maya and Leo learned Rosa's on Oak is closed Friday October 16 for renovations all week, so Friday pizza moved to Mario's on Pine Street at noon. Leo then cancelled due to a noon-to-afternoon deployment with manager saying don't move, leaving User and Maya still on to meet out front, User walking 10 minutes and Maya bussing.

As of October 14, 2026, Maya is on day 4 with no dairy, reporting no bloat and much better stomach though missing real cheese. Buttery garlic knots previously upset her stomach, so for Mario's she plans a marinara slice with no cheese, and at home eats tomato soup with dairy-free cheese that melts-ish for grilled cheese.

On the morning of October 14, 2026, Leo's laptop froze once and the restart didn't help, Maya's laptop froze once and she did the restart ritual twice with IT still ghosting her, and User's laptop dragged through standup after three restarts on October 13 failed, described as full toolkit fail.

User, Jen and Alex postponed their Friday plan on October 14, 2026. Jen cancelled because her sister arrives the night of October 15 requiring schedule shifts, Alex also cancelled citing a weird week, and all three agreed to raincheck with zero guilt and figure it out later.

User's dinner with Ben at Juniper Cafe at 45 Elm Street, originally Thursday at 7pm, was moved to Saturday October 17, 2026 at 7pm. Ben confirmed the change on October 14 after User agreed October 13 to switch from Thursday to Saturday, and User reconfirmed Saturday at 7pm at Juniper.

On October 14, 2026, Maya suggested possibly doing pizza Saturday for lunch if User is around, but User said not to book anything and could not commit because a family thing might move to Saturday with confirmation only by Friday October 16. Maya agreed to leave it open with no pressure.

Maya's sister's birthday gathering is Saturday October 17, 2026 at 4pm at Rosa's with ongoing worries about parking. On October 14 User reassured 4pm is chill and Maya advised a half order of knots to start, which her sister eye-rolled at while continuing to spam Maya about the event.

On October 14, 2026, User and Devon confirmed they are still on for Friday at the same time and same place, with Devon able to leave work on time for a rare win and User agreeing to text when parking. That evening User also declined staying late when their boss tried to keep them, noting exhaustion from late nights.

On October 14, 2026, 5th Street was still backed up by the bank with cones everywhere, which User and Devon discussed as permanent. User regretted not taking Oak and Devon said cutting through by the office wasn't much better, while Devon's boss was out so Devon avoided chart hell.

On October 14, 2026, User watered plants in the morning and they were okay for once, while Maya's miracle basil is still alive on the windowsill which saved its life. User's kitchen plants are jealous of the windowsill basil and User may move them this weekend but was too lazy that night.

On the evening of October 14, 2026, User and Maya were both in couch blanket mode with windows open feeling cold, reheating tomato soup gone lukewarm and cold. User heated soup again and still had half leftover from Monday October 12 to finish, while Maya had tomato soup with dairy-free grilled cheese.

On October 14, 2026, User told Jen and Alex a recent dentist appointment went fine and quick with only a little lecture about flossing, prompting jokes about flossing more. User also discussed lunches that day including leftovers, frozen pizza, pasta, and Alex possibly getting Thai pad thai that night.

On October 14, 2026, Maya's legs were dead from a morning gym leg day she called a mistake, continuing leg soreness from October 13. User, Maya and Leo were freezing at desks wearing heavy fall jackets all day, with Maya needing tea after coffee and remembering Leo's weird lemon tea and User's chamomile.

As of October 14, 2026, Jen is on episode 5 of the lighthouse show and says it's getting good with no spoilers, Alex is behind and plans to catch up that night, and User needs something to watch while folding laundry. Maya was also folding two shirts while listening to a chaotic food podcast joking Saturday is pizza's emotional support day.
